tenderSchedule.title: provide 24X7 onsite comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for the existing DELL PowerEdge servers, along with software
tenderSchedule.description: The scope of work for the successful bidder is to provide 24X7 onsite comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for the existing DELL PowerEdge servers, along with software.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Department of Treasuries, 5th 6th Floor, KPCL Green Building 3 Palace Road Bengaluru - 560001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of Covering letter as required in the given format (Refer Appendix-1)

Furnishing of the Power of Attorney Power of Attorney executed by the bidder in favour of the Principal Officer or duly Authorized Representative, certifying him/her as an authorized signatory for the purpose of this Tender.
The bidder should be a company registered under the Companies Act Copy of Certificate of Incorporation should be provided.
Bidder should hold valid GST certificate and Permanent Account Number (PAN) Copy of Valid GST certificate and Permanent Account Number (PAN) should be provided.

The bidder should have an annual turnover of at least 45 Lakhs, in the business of IT Hardware support services, each year in last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 Certified copy from Charted Accountant shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-2
The bidder should be a licensed dealer/authorized partner of OEM. MAF from DELL should be submitted.

The bidder shall not be under declaration of ineligibility for corrupt or fraudulent practices or deficiencies of services or blacklisted with any of the Government agencies at the time of bidding A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-4
Submission of Declaration of Acceptance of Terms & Conditions to RFP in the given format A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-5
Submission of Undertaking on litigation(s) in the given format A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-6
